measurementBoundary: Loopback HTTP to the real local API, including response parsing. Barcode-to-line includes barcode search plus add-line. Draft save is a versioned quantity change whose HTTP response follows the transaction commit; a read-after-write check is outside the timed sample.

presentation.note: Declared run metadata only. No renderer was started; locale and theme behavior were not validated.

networkState: Loopback API and local PostgreSQL; internet and peripherals not measured.

sampling.rawSampleValuesNote: This completed capture retained aggregate timing values only. The benchmark script now saves full-precision sample values on future runs.

targetInterpretation: The docs/quality.md targets are end-to-end interactions. These API-only results are a server-seam baseline and cannot establish target acceptance or minimum-profile certification.
